name: what-should-i-do
description: Daily ESO activity recommendations, tailored to your characters
author: Illyriat <contact@illyriat.com>

scripts.build:unpack: npm run check:addon && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.build:win: npm run check:addon && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: npm run check:addon && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run check:addon && npm run build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.publish: npm run check:addon && npm run build && electron-builder --publish always
